setup: The number is \(z = [[z]]\), and the question asks for \(1/z\).

steps.say: Multiply above and below by the conjugate \([[conjugate]]\), which leaves the value unchanged.
The denominator becomes \([[z]] \cdot [[conjugate]] = [[den]]\), a positive real number.
The numerator's real part is [[real_num]] and its imaginary part is [[imag_num]], both over [[den]].
